name: footer-curtain
title: Curtain footer
description: A footer that stays put while the page slides up over it, uncovering it like a curtain at the end of the scroll, in plain CSS.
docs: Wrap the page and give the footer: <FooterCurtain footer={<FooterSection … />}>{page}</FooterCurtain>. The page sits on an opaque raised layer and the footer is sticky to the bottom of the window beneath it. Keep the footer shorter than the window, or its top is cut off. minViewportHeight (default 640) is the window height below which the effect is off and the footer is an ordinary one; it is off in print too. Put it directly in the page's wrapper. Keyboard focus inside the footer lifts the curtain at once, so a focused link is never hidden under the page. It is pure CSS with no listener, so it works with native and with smooth scrolling.
